pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in points)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    max_r = max(r for r, _ in shape)
    max_c = max(c for _, c in shape)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(height - max_r):
        for left in range(width - max_c):
            cells = [(top + r, left + c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = marker
    return out
'''
